walkthroughs.body_html:
Topic 2: Education and Employment — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Topic 2: Education and Employment brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Topic 2: Education and Employment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I have been studying French for five years'?
options: j'étudie le français pour cinq ans
j'étudie le français depuis cinq ans
j'ai étudié le français depuis cinq ans
je vais étudier le français pour cinq ans
Like English 'on'.
beau (unchanged).
Silent.
As a nasal vowel - the n is not fully pronounced.

options: belles.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I was using my computer when the phone rang' in French?
options: J'ai utilisé mon ordinateur quand le téléphone a sonné.
J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.
J'utilisais mon ordinateur quand le téléphone a sonné.
Silent.
